**Job Title: Crowdstrike Implementation Engineer / PAM Implementation Engineer**  
**Duration: Contract (30+day engagement)**  
**Location: Remote**

**Overview**  
An organization is seeking a Crowdstrike Implementation Engineer/ PAM Implementation Engineer to lead the deployment of CrowdStrike Falcon Privileged Access Management (PAM) across the enterprise. This is a short-term, hands-on engagement covering the design, configuration, integration, testing, documentation, and operational handoff of the platform.

The engineer will work across Infrastructure, Security, Identity, Compliance, and Application teams to inventory privileged accounts, implement least-privilege controls, and eliminate standing administrative access. The role owns both implementation and the transition to day-to-day operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end implementation of CrowdStrike Falcon Privileged Access.
* Assess existing privileged accounts, administrative groups, service accounts, and elevated access risks.
* Design, configure, test, and deploy Just-In-Time (JIT) access policies, privilege duration controls, and role-based access controls.
* Integrate Falcon PAM with Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, and enterprise identity providers.
* Implement Microsoft Teams integrations, PAM browser extensions, approval chains, authorizer groups, and privilege revocation workflows.
* Automate privileged access requests, approvals, provisioning, revocation, and auditing.
* Build dashboards, reporting, monitoring, logging, and alerting, including SIEM integrations where applicable.
* Deliver architecture diagrams, administrative runbooks, and support procedures, and train administrators and support teams through knowledge transfer and operational handoff.

**Required Experience & Skills**

* Hands-on experience implementing Privileged Access Management (PAM) solutions, preferably CrowdStrike Falcon Privileged Access.
* Strong experience with Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD and Active Directory.
* Solid background in Identity & Access Management (IAM) and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).
* Experience with Just-In-Time (JIT) administration and least-privilege models.
* Windows Server administration experience.
* PowerShell scripting and API integration experience.
* Experience building workflow automation for access requests and approvals.
* Microsoft Teams administration experience.
* Experience with security monitoring, auditing, governance, and compliance.
* Ability to produce clear technical documentation and train technical and non-technical teams.
* Ability to work independently and deliver within a 30-day timeline.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with other PAM platforms (e.g., CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Delinea).
* Experience integrating with SIEM platforms (e.g., Microsoft Sentinel).
* Experience with CrowdStrike Falcon platform modules beyond PAM.
* Experience in a regulated environment (e.g., healthcare/HIPAA).
* Familiarity with AI-assisted scripting and documentation tools.

Pay: $70.00 - $90.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Experience:

* Privileged Access Management (PAM): 10 years (Required)
* CrowdStrike Privileged Access: 5 years (Required)
* CrowdStrike Falcon : 3 years (Required)
* Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD: 5 years (Required)

At First Advantage (Nasdaq: FA), people are at the heart of everything we do. From our customers and partners to our greatest advantage — our team members. Say hello to a rewarding career and come join a leading provider of mission-critical background screening solutions to some of the most recognized Fortune 100 and Global 500 brands.

**What You’ll Do****:**

As **Sr. Professional Services Manager** (Implementation) you will be the connective tissue between customer requirements and successful onboarding to the First Advantage program. Owning complex enterprise implementations from discovery through go-live, you will translate technical and operational requirements into practical business solutions, align customers and internal teams around clear decisions, and accelerate time to revenue without compromising quality or customer outcomes.

This is a senior, customer-facing role for someone who can move confidently between business strategy, solution design, project execution, and stakeholder influence. You will bring structure to ambiguity and guide customers toward scalable best-practice solutions.

This is a 100% remote position; however, the individual must be based in the United States and be available to travel up to 25%.

**Responsibilities**:

* Lead complex enterprise implementations across the First Advantage product portfolio, from discovery and solution design through configuration, testing, go-live, stabilization, and transition to Customer Success.

* Build and govern customer-centric implementation plans with clear scope, milestones, owners, dependencies, risks, decisions, and success measures.
* Negotiate scope, priorities, timelines, responsibilities, and solution choices with customers and internal stakeholders while maintaining trusted relationships.
* Orchestrate delivery across Sales, Product, Technology, Operations, Customer Success, ATS/HRIS partners, and customer teams, resolving blockers and holding stakeholders accountable.
* Lead integration planning, configuration, and pre- and post-production testing. Coding is not required, but technical fluency and strong solution leadership is essential.

* Use lessons learned and customer insights to improve implementation playbooks, reusable solutions, and delivery processes, while sharing expertise with peers.

**How You’ll Work**:

* High Emotional Intelligence: Listen actively, adapt your communication, and navigate challenging discussions while maintaining trust.
* Collaborative Influence: Build alignment without relying on authority and move teams toward clear decisions and shared accountability.
* Business Acumen: Connect implementation choices to customer outcomes, operational impact, revenue, risk, and scalability.
* Creative Curiosity: Ask incisive questions, explore root causes, and design practical solutions that balance customer needs with delivery standards.
* Learning Agility: Experiment thoughtfully, learn from setbacks, and adjust quickly without losing momentum.

* Customers understand the implementation path, decisions required, and responsibilities needed to adopt the agreed solution.
* Projects are tightly scoped and actively governed, with transparent ownership, risks, decisions, and next steps.
* Solutions are technically feasible, commercially sound, scalable, and aligned with best practice.
* Cross-functional teams align early, blockers are resolved quickly, and avoidable rework and customization are reduced.
* Implementations reach go-live and first revenue with speed, predictability, and customer confidence.

* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent professional work experience.
* 7+ years leading complex enterprise implementations, professional services engagements, solution delivery, or comparable customer onboarding programs in B2B SaaS.
* Demonstrated strength in discovery, requirements gathering, solution design, scope and risk management, project governance, testing, and launch readiness.
* Proven ability to negotiate, influence through expertise and data, and hold customer and internal stakeholders accountable to commitments.
* Ability to translate integrations, APIs, data exchange, configuration, and ATS/HRIS concepts into clear business implications and actionable recommendations. Coding experience is not required.
* Excellent facilitation, executive presence, presentation, written communication, analytical judgment, and cross-functional leadership skills.
* Experience partnering with Sales or pre-sales, Product, Technology, Operations, and Client Success.

Helpful, But Not Required

  

* Experience in background screening, HR technology, HCM, identity, compliance technology, or another complex or regulated B2B environment such as financial services or healthcare.
* Solutions consulting, technical account management, or pre-sales solutioning experience.
* Experience using AI-enabled tools, automation, or analytics to improve implementation speed, quality, documentation, or decision-making.
* Formal project or change management certification.
